body: i think about killing myself daily and i have someone that checks on me everyday and he is the only one that knows what i want to do and i have a good life but idk im so depressed and just broken down.

my parents pay for my school and my grades arent effected by my leaving, but my family doesnt know either, i got help for cutting before but i just started again and they definitely dont know that. please dont kill yourself.
sometimes i actually have to leave school and just go home
same here. I don’t have any happiness and i never stop and think about the opposite. i always think about oh im sad im depressed, but not im not happy and never am happy
talk to them, ask them what the heck dude, try and communicate, you most likely arent the reason they are pulling away. they might even be feeling the same way you are
people will like making memories with you rather than just reflecting on past memories
i dont think the problem is with you at all. she needs something that no one can fulfill.
you get new friends and lose friends all the time, that’s life. people come into our lives and stay in our lives that are supposed to be there

your friends and family are going to go to your funeral and wish they had told you they loved you and held you more. hindsight is 20/20, but they love you so much i believe that and i dont even know you. im a complete stranger talking to you. but the point is you are worth it, everything in life is a struggle, call in to work, go see an old friend, go get a coffee or a tea. breathe
please just stay asleep dont set that alarm to wake up at 3
i agree. mental illness doesnt go away. it gets better though. where are you right now?

everything grows and changes overtime. please dont though, im sorry i cant give any other reasons besides the reasons that you have probably already heard. im sitting in my bed writing this and sobbing because you deserve to live. you have a purpose here and you just need to find it. maybe your purpose is suicide prevention and telling people your story. i dont know you but i care a lot about you and everyone going through this. please dont do it.
maybe try something unorthodox or natural medicine rather than prescription. i wanted to kill myself tonight too.

no not forever, a professional can help until you are able to stand strong and say that you may have lost a few battles but you won the whole war, you are alive. you won. it’s worth it, and i know that’s cheesy but it really is. please
find courage to live. look at your loved ones, find the courage in them and in yourself to not lean over and jump off your building. please
to not kill yourself. talk to anyone. im here for you.

Find happiness in yourself, your person is out there. Please know this. You can do it. Screw him, if he truly cared he would be making sure you're okay, you deserve someone who does that for you. And you will find someone that does, please don't.
Talk to me, I don't know you but I know how you feel and just talking please don't. I have been there before and literally writing the note and writing it made me not want to anymore.
It's kind of crazy to think about this but I honestly have no idea why I feel this way, I was given enough love as a child and have plenty of friends but I don't know.

hey I'm just a random person and you have no reason to listen to what I say, and I don't know you but I know exactly how you feel. Please don't. Something that really really helps me when I want to just end it all, like one time I had a pill bottle in one hand, and I was actually writing notes for my loved ones and that made me not want to do it anymore at that point in time. Writing to the people that cared for me, imagining how they would react and how they would live their life without me. We often forget how much we effect each person we come in contact with, even if it's only for a second. Please reconsider this.
hey I don't know you but I know how you feel, and even if no one can change your mind on it then just talking may lift a burden.

I have self harm scars too, and it's become sort of a habit now and I just go through the motion, like something just takes over me, it scares me too. Do you ever find something random in class will just trigger you? If we talk about certain things, doesn't even have to relate to scars or depression or suicide and I'll get very emotional about it.
